correctness.rationale: Squarefreeness of xQ(x³) in characteristic 11 is equivalent to bΔ≠0, yielding a genus-four smooth completion. The coefficients of f^5 at indices 11i−j have exactly the displayed three disjoint blocks. On b≠0 the first outer block vanishes only at (0,−2). For the other block v_2−3v_1=aL: a=0 again gives (0,−2); a=4 gives only b=−2, which is singular; otherwise substituting (1−3a)b=−a²+3a+4 gives the cleared powers of a−4, excluding any further simultaneous zero over the algebraic closure. At (0,−2), Δ=10 and P=5, so precisely the Frobenius-stable middle direction survives; Cartier rank and 11-rank are both one. Everywhere else the outer blocks contribute two, so the smooth P=0 locus has a-number two and the remaining locus has a-number one. `python3 /workspace/reviews/evidence/reproduce.py 1` used independent multinomial coefficient extraction, exact polynomial reductions, a squarefree gcd and modular minors on all 121 base-field pairs, obtaining 101 smooth parameters and counts 83,17,1. The finite enumeration is not the proof over the closure. The supplied scripts were inspected, not executed.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A lower bound or classification of rank zero cannot distinguish rank one from ranks two and three. The general matrix machinery still requires the characteristic-specific elimination.
